name: Nescafe
location: Beside H1 Hostel, between Bus Stop 4 and H1 Hostel
description: Nescafe is one of the most popular food outlets on the IIITDM Jabalpur campus. It serves coffee, tea, beverages, burgers, sandwiches, snacks, desserts, fresh juices, and other fast-food items. Students frequently visit Nescafe for meals, group discussions, evening refreshments, and late-night snacks.
faqs: What food items are available at Nescafe?
additional_information: One of the most frequently visited food outlets on campus.

name: Amul
description: Amul is a popular campus dairy and snack outlet offering ice creams, milk-based beverages, dairy products, snacks, and refreshments. It is a preferred place for students looking for quick snacks, cold drinks, and desserts throughout the day.
faqs: What products are available at Amul?
Can I buy milk products at Amul?
additional_information: Popular for dairy products and ice creams.
Located near the Primary Health Centre (PHC).

name: Hexagon
description: Hexagon is the campus food court located in the academic area. It provides meals, snacks, and beverages, making it a convenient place for students and faculty during class hours.
faqs: What food is available at Hexagon?
additional_information: Primarily serves students and faculty during academic hours.

name: Maa Saraswati Canteen
description: Maa Saraswati Canteen is located inside the Maa Saraswati Girls Hostel. It serves breakfast, lunch, dinner, tea, beverages, and snacks throughout the day and remains one of the few food outlets on campus open until late night.
faqs: What are Maa Saraswati Canteen timings?
Is Maa Saraswati Canteen open now?
Is it open till late night?
additional_information: Only allowed for girls hostel residents and visitors.

name: H1 Canteen
location: Inside H1 Hostel, left side after entering.
description: H1 Canteen is located inside Hostel 1 (Vasishta Hostel). It serves lunch, dinner, snacks, tea, coffee, beverages, and fast food. Delivery service is available for students.
faqs: Can day scholars visit H1 Canteen?
additional_information: Delivery service is available.
Girls are allowed inside the hostel premises only until 10:30 PM as per hostel rules.

name: H4 Canteen
description: H4 Canteen is located inside Hostel 4 and serves meals, snacks, tea, coffee, beverages, and fast food for hostel residents and students visiting the hostel.
faqs: What food is available at H4 Canteen?
additional_information: Operating hours may vary depending on the vendor.
Timings will be updated once officially confirmed.

name: Central Mess
location: Beside H3 Hostel, near the Cricket Ground
description: The Central Mess is the primary dining facility for students residing on campus. It serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner every day according to the scheduled timings.
faqs: What are the Central Mess timings?
Can non-registered students eat in the mess?
additional_information: Registered students can dine using their mess registration.
Non-registered students must pay separately for meals.

name: Primary Health Centre (PHC)
description: The Primary Health Centre (PHC) provides basic healthcare services to students, faculty, and staff. It offers doctor consultations, first aid, basic medical treatment, and prescribed medicines for common illnesses and minor injuries.
faqs: Can students get medicines from PHC?
What medical services are available at PHC?
additional_information: Students should carry their institute ID while visiting.
For serious medical emergencies, patients may be referred to a nearby hospital.

name: Dean Student Affairs (DSA) Office
description: The Dean Student Affairs (DSA) Office is responsible for student-related administrative services including certificates, approvals, scholarships, hostel matters, student grievances, and other academic support services.
faqs: How can I get a bonafide certificate?
Where should I submit student applications?
additional_information: Office remains closed on institute holidays.
Students should carry their institute ID while visiting.

name: Lecture Hall and Tutorial Complex (LHTC)
description: The Lecture Hall and Tutorial Complex (LHTC) houses lecture halls and tutorial classrooms where regular academic classes, tutorials, seminars, workshops, and examinations are conducted.
additional_information: Students should follow the academic timetable for classroom allocation.

name: Core Lab Complex (CLC)
description: The Core Lab Complex (CLC) houses laboratories used for practical courses, academic experiments, research activities, and project work across various engineering disciplines.
faqs: Which laboratories are located in CLC?
Are practical classes conducted in CLC?
How can I find my laboratory?
additional_information: Laboratory access depends on the academic timetable and instructor permissions.

name: Central Library
description: The Central Library provides access to books, journals, digital resources, study spaces, and reading halls. It supports academic learning, research, and self-study for students and faculty.
faqs: Can students study in the library?
What resources are available in the library?
additional_information: Institute ID may be required for issuing books.
Students are expected to maintain silence inside the library.

name: Student Activity Centre (SAC)
description: The Student Activity Centre (SAC) is the main recreational and fitness facility on campus. It provides indoor sports facilities, a gymnasium, spaces for student clubs, cultural activities, and various campus events.
faqs: What sports facilities are available in SAC?
additional_information: Students may need their institute ID to access certain facilities.
Timings for individual sports facilities may vary.

name: Open Air Theatre (OAT)
description: The Open Air Theatre (OAT) is the institute's outdoor venue for cultural programs, club activities, festivals, and other large student events. It serves as one of the primary gathering spaces for the campus community.
faqs: Where is the Open Air Theatre located?
What events are held at OAT?
Are movie screenings conducted at OAT?
Can students organize events at OAT?
additional_information: The venue is generally accessible during institute-approved events.
Entry requirements may vary depending on the event.
Most major cultural festivals and institute gatherings are conducted here.
